title: heroberin
description: Herobrine but from temu! Still in progress.
body: This mod adds what seems like herobrine... but something is off. There will be 2 new mobs [heroberin, and one secret], new structures, biome and even new dimension! Mod is still in progress, i will add new features! You can find heroberin on biome called **heroberin forest** in special house in whitch there are traps, and recipe to summon new boss: heroberin. If you kill him [he can fly btw] you would get heroberin weapon. It has new GUI in with you have many super powers, like summoning lightings etc. You can disguise this weapon as seeds by putting it in crafting table, and recraft it by putting seeds again in crafting slots. For admins there's new dimension. You can get there by building frame out of herobrock [secret creative item] and lighting it using heroberin igniter [heroberin weapon + flint and steel in crafting].
